title: Diabetes mellitus: type, complications and medication status
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's diabetes, its complications and related long-term drug use.
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for routine monitoring of type 2 diabetes.

History of Present Illness
The patient presents for follow-up management of type 2 diabetes. They report that blood glucose levels have been trending toward hyperglycemia recently, and they feel their glucose management is poorly controlled. The patient continues to use long-term insulin for management of their type 2 diabetes. They deny any acute changes since the last visit.

Medication List
Insulin, dosage and timing unchanged.

Exam
Vitals are stable. Skin exam is intact with no signs of acute infection noted. Cardiovascular and pulmonary exams are unremarkable.

Assessment
The patient has type 2 diabetes mellitus with current evidence of hyperglycemia and poorly controlled glucose status on insulin therapy.

Plan
Continue current insulin regimen. Patient educated on monitoring blood glucose levels and adherence to insulin schedule. Follow up in three months.
explanations: Diabetes documented as poorly controlled, out of control, or with hyperglycemia is coded to diabetes with hyperglycemia.
Long-term insulin use in type 2 diabetes: add Z79.4.

distractors.why: Hyperglycemia is a complication with its own code.
Z79.4 is required for routine insulin use in type 2 diabetes.
